sentences.Huff da, hva er i veien med deg?: Oh dear, what's wrong with you?
I feel sick and I have a stomach ache.
And I have a headache and a sore throat.
sentences.Det tror jeg. Minst 40. Og det verker i: I think so. At least 40. And I ache all over.
Then you have to go to the doctor.
sentences.Vel ... Jeg var hos legen for to dager s: Well ... I was at the doctor's two days ago.
sentences.Jeg fikk ikke noe medisin. Hun sa at jeg: I didn't get any medicine. She said I had a bit of a cold.
But now I'm going to book a new appointment.
sentences.Jeg får ikke sove om natta. Kanskje jeg: I can't sleep at night. Maybe I should go to the emergency clinic.
sentences.Puh! Neste gang sier jeg bare hei!: Phew! Next time I'll just say hi!
sentences.Michelle møter Terje, en ung mann i nabo: Michelle meets Terje, a young man in the neighbourhood.
sentences.Han forteller at han føler seg syk, og a: He says that he feels ill, and that he feels sick and aches all over.
He thinks he has a temperature of 40.
He was at the doctor's a few days ago.
But his doctor didn't give him any medicine.
She said he had a bit of a cold.
Michelle thinks he complains too much.
